name: jghtable
description: ZSUN Club static SPAs (AG Grid) deployed to Azure Blob Storage

scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean && node -e "for (const path of ['shared-mastercopies/dist', 'dirt-racing-series/dist', 'wtrl-zrl-league/dist', 'zsun-club-curve-fits/dist', 'zsun-club-membership/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
